You tell your quarry why you came, then step in and strike to stop their retreat.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Bring the pursuit to a close with a melee attack. Against a quarry you marked with Name the Reckoning, gain 1 Boon; that card is helpful, not required.

Weak
5 physical damage.
Standard
5 physical damage and Slowed 2.
Strong
7 physical damage, Slowed 2 and knock prone.
